ekiben.title: Ekiben & Essentials

items.detail: Japan's largest ekiben shop (200+ varieties). Central Passage near Yaesu South Gate. ~5:30–23:00.

picks.name: Ebi Senryo Chirashi
picks.note: Shrimp and egg over sushi rice.

picks.name: Il Forno del Mignon
picks.note: Mini-croissants sold by weight. Near Hakata Gate. Legendary.

solo_tips: Ticket machines (shokkenki): insert money, press button, hand ticket to chef.
Avoid lunch 12:00–13:00, dinner 18:30–20:00 for shorter waits.
Konbini (7-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart): onigiri ¥120–180, egg sandwiches ¥200–300.
Depachika (dept. store basements): premium bento, sashimi, free samples. Key: Daimaru (Osaka, Hakata), Isetan (Kyoto).
ekiben.coin_locker_tip: On Days 4, 8, 12, 17: stash rolling bag in a station coin locker before eating at counter-only spots. Counter restaurants have NO room for luggage. Most major stations: ¥400 (small), ¥500 (medium), ¥700 (large). IC card operated.

restaurants.order: Kakinoha-zushi set with chagayu (tea porridge) — ¥1,820. Mackerel & salmon sushi in persimmon leaves + warm porridge. Or buy a mixed box (¥1,000–1,200) for the train.
restaurants.note: Est. 1861 in Yoshino. Nara's quintessential specialty. The vinegar rice uses local Hinohikari rice. Buy extra as omiyage. Takeout shop (登大路店) also near station, 9:00–19:00 daily.
Seasonal varieties (saba, sake, tai). Eat-in set available.

restaurants.order: Sashimi of the day + 'nomeru salmon' (signature melt-in-mouth salmon sushi). Pair with local sake.
restaurants.note: Chain operation (nationwide), but quality sushi at izakaya prices. Reservations accepted online.
